column1: # Game profile of N++ (Switch, update 1.0.7 = v458752).
# Metanet Software / C++ on SDL and OpenGL through EGL, SDK 4.5.0: the game data is in the RomFS (NPP/
# Palettes, Sounds, Music, Shaders, Levels). It renders with NVIDIA's desktop OpenGL 3.2 through EGL:
# main imports EGL and takes GL calls from eglGetProcAddress, which the host's GL layer answers on Metal
# (dm/gfx/gl/hle_gl.m). NVIDIA's GL driver (subsdk0) is never loaded.
# The shaders are loose GLSL files in the RomFS (NPP/Shaders/glsl/*.vert and *.frag) translated offline
# by dm/gfx/tools/gl_shaders.py; the host finds each by the hash of its source text.
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# no NVN shaders: the profile's NVN tables stay empty and the GL library comes from gl_shaders.py

column2: N++ has no NVN shaders (its GLSL shaders go through the GL layer)
